versions.content: For messages sent via IF (Size in Table is 8), the transmission is terminated when J1939Dcm_TxConfirmation is called after transmission of a requested message which has been accepted and processed according to [SWS_J1939Dcm_00007] . The J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall then release the buffer of [SWS_J1939Dcm_00115] .
